answer: Reaching the ocean of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the vault until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lantern of the next round.
